summary: Stormheim is the eastern end of the Broken Isles: fjords, ravines and amber woods cut out of the rock by the sea, covered in vrykul monuments. The vrykul here live between two afterlives that are both directly overhead — Odyn's Halls of Valor in the clouds and Helya's Helheim under the water — and the clans are split over which one they serve. The Legion's bargain has already taken the Tideskorn, and the Alliance and Horde have landed on the same coast looking for the Aegis of Aggramar.
history: The vrykul took this land from Highborne occupants under King Magnar Icebreaker, only for Helya's followers to murder Magnar and his son in the hour of their victory. Millennia later, with the Halls of Valor hanging in the sky as Odyn's prison, vrykul crossed from Northrend in numbers to live beneath them and hope for a place among the Valarjar; Helya's kvaldir have been picking off their dead ever since. When the Legion returned, Prince Skovald of the Tideskorn made a pact with the demons, killed his father, then his brothers, then his mother, and made himself God-King with fel-corrupted Felskorn at his back. The two Azerothian factions arrived, and promptly fought each other.
